conditional_mechanism_synthesis.when: A listed-consolidated cement issuer discloses an acquisition, restructuring or joint-venture perimeter condition.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.decision: No company decision sequence is asserted from the H1 packet.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.mechanism: A change in the reporting perimeter may alter the composition of a reported operating or cash series.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.observed_as: A perimeter-continuity question attached to the affected issuer and cutoff.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.unless: A cutoff-visible bridge establishes the same responsibility boundary and field definition.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.counterexamples: A stable reported field alone is not evidence that the business state, management action or cash mechanism is comparable.

unresolved_questions.question: Which cutoff-visible source, if any, establishes alternatives, commitment, execution and adaptation for a material management decision at a consistent responsibility boundary?
unresolved_questions.materiality: Without it, management quality, capital allocation and action-effect conclusions remain unsupported.
unresolved_questions.next_evidence: Board, implementation or other official disclosure that identifies the action, responsible unit, timing and perimeter.

unresolved_questions.question: Can the next disclosure provide a field-level perimeter bridge for Huaxin and Jidong before operating comparisons are made?
unresolved_questions.materiality: A missing bridge can change the interpretation of operating cash and permanent-loss conditions.
unresolved_questions.next_evidence: Official annual-report reconciliation that names transferred assets, scope, timing and same-boundary fields.

next_sampling_decision.decision: Sample a later cutoff only after preserving the five-company risk set and retaining scope-break issuers as distinct lifecycle archetypes.
next_sampling_decision.rationale: The next sample should discriminate boundary continuity or add a bounded operating-to-cash field, not seek an easy Comparative pass.
